title: Bare .slnx project entries build under EVERY configuration — Debug F5 builds your installer
symptoms: F5/Debug build fails with WiX cabinet errors even though nobody asked for an installer
good_pattern: <Build Solution="Release|Any CPU" Project="Release" />  <!-- and no entry for Debug -->
explanation: A bare <Project> entry in .slnx builds under every solution configuration, Debug included. Scope wixproj entries with an explicit <Build Solution="Release|Any CPU" Project="Release" /> and omit Debug. Caution: vs-solutionpersistence issue #138 — VS 'Save All' can silently re-add a bare <Build /> that undoes this; if the symptom returns, check the .slnx for it before re-deriving anything. Prefer hand-editing .slnx for these entries.
